The <=3 locus partitions into 92 orbits under five generators independently certified to span GL3(F3); all 92 representatives receive exact projective-chart Jacobian ideal unit tests over GF3. Exactly two smooth size-312 orbits remain. Independently generated Python tables match every C++ constant and direct symbolic line tests, with rational-point counts one and ten.
